claims: The Kennedy Space Center (KSC) is on Merritt Island, Florida.
NASA primarily launches its major crewed and exploration missions from the Kennedy Space Center (KSC).
The Artemis II mission launched April 2026.
Space Launch System (SLS) launches take place at Launch Complex 39B.
Kennedy Space Center (KSC) is in Florida.
Kennedy Space Center (KSC) is the primary location for human spaceflight and large exploration missions.
Cape Canaveral Space Force Station is in Florida.
Cape Canaveral Space Force Station is adjacent to KSC.
Vandenberg Space Force Base is in California.
Vandenberg Space Force Base is used for polar-orbit missions.
Wallops Flight Facility is in Virginia.
Wallops Flight Facility is used for small rockets and scientific missions.
Florida's Space Coast is KSC/Cape Canaveral.
The easterly, coastal location allows for safe trajectory over the Atlantic Ocean.
